results.incidentcategorycustomerfriendlydescript:
We regularly inspect electrical equipment in your area to help keep your electricity supply safe and reliable. As part of this programme, we will be replacing and upgrading 15 electricity poles over the course of 5 days. These poles play an important role in helping us deliver a safe and reliable supply to homes and businesses. This work will also reduce the likelihood of unexpected power cuts in the future. We appreciate your area has been impacted with unplanned power cuts in the last 6 months. To maintain your electricity supply during the work, we'll temporarily connect your property to a generator. There will be brief interruptions to your power while it is connected and removed.
If you have solar panels, please switch them off to keep them safely isolated. If your system has an 'island mode' (sometimes called backup or standby mode) you can use that instead. This work is taking place in the Marshcroft Lane area. A road closure will be in place from the 16th to the 20th November

We hope to be able to restore your supplies by the planned time of 10:30.  Please accept our sincere apologies for any inconvenience this is causing.

results.incidentcategorycustomerfriendlydescript: Some trees in your area have grown too close to the overhead power lines. If they are not cut back, branches could touch the lines and cause unexpected interruptions to your electricity supply. This work has been requested by a 3rd party and will be completed by their appointed tree surgeon. Our engineers need to temporarily switch off your power so a tree surgeon can safely cut back trees near the overhead power lines. This will help reduce the risk of unexpected power cuts in the future and support a safe, reliable electricity supply. We appreciate that some customers may have experienced unplanned power cuts in the last 6 months. This work is taking place in the Breach Lane area. A road closure will be in place by the 3rd Party to allow the works to be carried out safely.
